instruction.text: Find the item that is unsafe to be near an electrical circuit.

atoms.a: Why is it unsafe to have water near an electrical circuit?
b: ++It could spill onto the circuit and cause an electrical fire.
++It could spill onto the circuit and cause electrocution.
It could spill onto the circuit and cool it down.

trainers.instruction: How can water cause electrical fires? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Water conducts electricity, which can cause an appliance to ((++short-circuit disappear)). This causes the wires to ((++heat_up cool_down)) and set on fire.

trainers.instruction: How do broken wires cause fires? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Wires are usually wrapped in ((++an_insulator a_conductor)). When a wire is broken, the live wires are ((++exposed contained)) and can cause fires or electrocution.

trainers.instruction: How do fuses protect from electrical fires? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Fuses prevent the flow of electricity from becoming too ((++strong weak)), which helps components to avoid ((++overheating cooling_down)).
